description.value: Shore is a casual beachside restaurant on the oceanfront in Qualicum Beach, serving fresh, locally sourced fish and chips, fish tacos, burgers, and specialty desserts including Dole Whip. The restaurant features a beautiful ocean-front patio alongside one of Vancouver Island's best beaches and boardwalks, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists on the Island Highway route. A take-out window means cyclists can grab food without leaving their gear outside unattended.

address.value: 2831 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C4

Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'our take out window is a great option'; vegetarian/vegan/GF options are confirmed by menu items including a Veggie Burger, Impossible Burger, and Dole Whip described as 'vegan and gluten free'.
